paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relative change across multiple layers, comparing several configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and displays categorical values: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change," with a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, and tick labels at -15%, -10%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. A gray line, with diamond markers and solid style, representing “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit,” starts at approximately -2% at Layer1-4 and declines to approximately -13% at Layer29-32. A blue line, with circle markers and solid style, representing “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit,” begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -15% at Layer29-32. A darker blue dashed line, representing “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit,” starts at approximately -2% at Layer1-4 and declines to around -13% at Layer29-32. A black line, with square markers and solid style, representing “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit,” begins near -1% at Layer1-4 and decreases to approximately -12% at Layer29-32. A gray dashed line, representing “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”, begins at approximately 0% at Layer1-4 and remains approximately at 0% throughout the entire x-axis range and concludes at approximately 0% at Layer29-32.
